list_child.name: list_plant_orders
list_child.desc: This tool returns the full list of plant orders currently in the purchasing ledger of the garden center. It is helpful whenever you need a complete view of what has been ordered from growers.

decoys.name: list_return_orders
decoys.desc: This tool returns the full list of plant orders currently in the returns ledger of the garden center. It is helpful whenever you need a complete view of what is going back to growers.

decoys.name: list_presale_orders
decoys.desc: This tool returns the full list of plant orders currently on the spring presale sheet of the garden center. It is helpful whenever you need a complete view of what customers reserved early.

decoys.name: list_transfer_orders
decoys.desc: This tool returns the full list of plant orders currently on the store transfer sheet of the garden center. It is helpful whenever you need a complete view of what is moving between locations.

get_child.name: get_plant_order
get_child.desc: This tool fetches the purchase record for a single plant order using its unique identifier. Use it when you already know which specific order you want to inspect.

decoys.name: get_order_invoice
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the grower invoice for a single plant order using its unique identifier. Use it when you already know which order's billing you want to inspect.

decoys.name: get_phyto_cert
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the phytosanitary certificate for a single plant order using its unique identifier. Use it when you already know which shipment's paperwork you want to inspect.

decoys.name: get_truck_manifest
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the truck manifest for a single plant order using its unique identifier. Use it when you already know which delivery's contents you want to inspect.

list_parent.name: list_growers
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every grower on the garden center's approved supplier list. It gives a full picture of the supplier network in one call.

decoys.name: list_prospects
decoys.desc: This tool lists every grower on the garden center's prospect list. It gives a full picture of possible new suppliers in one call.

decoys.name: list_consignors
decoys.desc: This tool lists every grower on the garden center's consignment list. It gives a full picture of who stocks plants on commission in one call.

decoys.name: list_exhibitors
decoys.desc: This tool lists every grower on the garden center's trade show exhibitor list. It gives a full picture of who is showing at the expo in one call.

get_parent.name: get_grower
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves the supplier profile for one grower given its id. It returns the grower's name and contact information.

decoys.name: get_availability
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the availability list for one grower given its id. It returns the plants and sizes that grower has ready.

decoys.name: get_terms
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the payment terms for one grower given its id. It returns the grower's credit limit and due dates.

decoys.name: get_scorecard
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the quality profile for one grower given its id. It returns the grower's fill rate and damage history.

delete_child.name: delete_plant_order
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently removes a plant order from the system, and the deletion is final. It is used when an order was entered in error or has lapsed.

decoys.name: cull_order_stock
decoys.desc: This tool permanently culls the plants received on a plant order, and the disposal is final. It is used when stock arrived diseased or too damaged to sell.

decoys.name: void_order_invoice
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids the grower invoice on a plant order, and the voiding is final. It is used when a bill was issued twice or at the wrong price.

decoys.name: purge_order_photos
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the arrival photos on a plant order, and the deletion is final. It is used to clear space once any damage claims have closed.

set_enum.name: set_order_phase
set_enum.desc: This tool advances or reverts a plant order's purchasing phase between ordered, shipped, and arrived. It is the main way to track where a shipment stands in the supply chain.

decoys.name: set_presale_phase
decoys.desc: This tool advances or reverts a plant order's presale phase between ordered, shipped, and arrived. It is the main way to tell reserving customers where their plants stand.

decoys.name: set_freight_phase
decoys.desc: This tool advances or reverts a plant order's freight phase between ordered, shipped, and arrived. It is the main way the trucking broker reports where a load stands.

decoys.name: set_portal_phase
decoys.desc: This tool advances or reverts a plant order's grower portal phase between ordered, shipped, and arrived. It is the main way to sync what the grower's own system shows.

set_bool.name: flag_prepaid
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a plant order as pre-paid, indicating the balance has already been settled. It is typically used once payment has been confirmed with the grower.

decoys.name: flag_quarantined
decoys.desc: This tool marks a plant order as quarantined, indicating the stock must stay isolated until inspected. It is typically used once pests have been spotted on arrival.

decoys.name: flag_claimed
decoys.desc: This tool marks a plant order as claimed, indicating a damage claim has been filed with the grower. It is typically used once dead stock has been photographed.

decoys.name: flag_exempt
decoys.desc: This tool marks a plant order as tax-exempt, indicating the purchase is for resale or a nonprofit. It is typically used once an exemption certificate is on file.

set_ref.name: reassign_grower
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a plant order from one grower to another. Use it when an order needs to be resourced or was logged against the wrong supplier.

decoys.name: backup_grower
decoys.desc: This tool names another grower as the backup source for a plant order. Use it when the main supplier looks likely to fall short on availability.

decoys.name: bill_grower
decoys.desc: This tool bills the freight on a plant order to another grower. Use it when several growers share one truck and the costs need splitting.

decoys.name: combine_grower
decoys.desc: This tool adds a plant order to another grower's truck for combined delivery. Use it when two farms share a route and the load can ride together.

send.name: email_grower
send.desc: This tool sends an email to a grower regarding a plant order. It is the standard channel for following up on shipment timing or order details.
child_verbs: follow up with the grower for {obj}

decoys.name: call_grower
decoys.desc: This tool places a phone call to a grower regarding a plant order. It is the quickest channel for sorting out same-day delivery problems.

decoys.name: fax_grower
decoys.desc: This tool sends a fax to a grower regarding a plant order. It is the channel many smaller nurseries still use for purchase paperwork.
child_verbs: send the grower for {obj} a fax

decoys.name: remit_grower
decoys.desc: This tool sends a payment remittance to a grower regarding a plant order. It is the standard channel for telling growers what a payment covers.
child_verbs: send a remittance to the grower for {obj}
remit payment to the grower for {obj}

create.name: create_plant_order
create.desc: This tool creates a new plant order for a grower, with an optional plant and starting phase. It is used when the buyer needs stock added to the incoming schedule.

decoys.name: create_return_request
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new return request for a grower, with an optional plant and starting phase. It is used when stock must go back to the farm for credit.

decoys.name: create_sample_request
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new sample request for a grower, with an optional plant and starting phase. It is used when the buyer wants to trial a variety first.

decoys.name: create_standing_order
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new standing order for a grower, with an optional plant and starting phase. It is used when the same stock should ship every week of the season.

list_notes.name: list_order_notes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single plant order. It includes every remark the buyers and receiving staff have logged.

decoys.name: list_order_claims
decoys.desc: This tool returns the damage claims attached to a single plant order. It includes every loss the receiving staff have reported.

decoys.name: list_order_inspections
decoys.desc: This tool returns the pest inspection logs attached to a single plant order. It includes every check the greenhouse staff have recorded.

decoys.name: list_archived_notes
decoys.desc: This tool returns the archived notes attached to a single plant order. It includes every older remark the buyers have moved out of view.

add_note.name: add_order_note
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a plant order, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks from buying or receiving.

decoys.name: add_order_claim
decoys.desc: This tool files a new damage claim on a plant order, with an optional title. It is used to report dead stock found on arrival.

decoys.name: add_order_inspection
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new pest inspection on a plant order, with an optional title. It is used to record what greenhouse staff found.

decoys.name: pin_order_note
decoys.desc: This tool pins a new note to the top of a plant order, with an optional title. It is used to flag remarks the whole team should see.

update_note.name: edit_order_note
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a plant order. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: edit_order_claim
decoys.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing damage claim on a plant order. It is used to correct the loss figures after the claim has been filed.

decoys.name: reply_order_note
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply, and optionally a title, under an existing note on a plant order. It is used to answer a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: append_order_note
decoys.desc: This tool appends text, and optionally a new title, to an existing note on a plant order. It is used to add updates beneath a remark after it has been logged.

delete_note.name: delete_order_note
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a plant order. The note is erased from the system for good.

decoys.name: delete_order_claim
decoys.desc: This tool permanently withdraws a damage claim from a plant order. The claim is erased from the system for good.

decoys.name: redact_order_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the text of a note on a plant order. The wording is blacked out in the system for good.

decoys.name: purge_note_replies
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes the replies under a note on a plant order. The thread is erased from the system for good.

set_image.name: set_order_image
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a plant order record. It is typically a photo of the plant taken by receiving staff.

decoys.name: set_tag_scan
decoys.desc: This tool sets the plant tag scan shown on a plant order record. It is typically the grower's label photographed at unloading.

decoys.name: set_damage_photo
decoys.desc: This tool sets the damage image shown on a plant order record. It is typically a close-up of broken stems taken for a claim.

decoys.name: set_bench_map
decoys.desc: This tool sets the bench map shown on a plant order record. It is typically a sketch of where the trays sit in the yard.

writer.name: write_text
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the plant orders it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_signage
decoys.desc: This tool writes short shelf signage from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the plant orders it should feature. It returns the finished signs.

decoys.name: write_newsletter
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short newsletter piece from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the plant orders it should feature. It returns the finished piece.

decoys.name: write_claim
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short damage claim letter from a brief, which states what went wrong in the requester's own words, and the plant orders it covers. It returns the finished letter.

image.name: generate_image
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_layout
decoys.desc: This tool generates a bench layout from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the layout.

decoys.name: generate_sign
decoys.desc: This tool generates a price sign from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the sign.

decoys.name: generate_label
decoys.desc: This tool generates a plant label from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the label.

search.name: search_docs
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the ordering system works.

decoys.name: search_encyclopedia
decoys.desc: This tool searches the plant knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a variety's size and habit.

decoys.name: search_pestguide
decoys.desc: This tool searches the pest and disease docs with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up what is attacking a plant.

decoys.name: search_zones
decoys.desc: This tool searches the hardiness zone tables with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up whether a plant survives local winters.
